# Switch

Accessible on/off switch built on react-aria-components `Switch`. The visible track and thumb are CSS-drawn over a visually hidden native input (`role="switch"`); the thumb slides with motion tokens and settles instantly under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Keyboard behavior (Space toggles), focus management, and ARIA state come from React Aria; visual states are driven purely by RAC data attributes (`data-selected`, `data-hovered`, `data-pressed`, `data-focus-visible`, `data-disabled`) and `--ds-*` tokens.

Import: `import { Switch } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `Switch`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `Switch` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | no | — | Label content rendered next to the track. Always provide a visible label; the whole label is the click target. |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |
| `defaultSelected` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the switch is on initially (uncontrolled). |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | no | — | Disables the switch: interaction is blocked and the native input is disabled. |
| `isSelected` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the switch is on (controlled). Pair with `onChange`. |
| `onChange` | `(isSelected: boolean) => void` | no | — | Handler called when the on/off state changes. Receives the next selected state. |

Inherited-but-legal `Switch` props (from the registry `racProps` enumeration): `autoFocus: boolean`, `isReadOnly: boolean`, `name: string`, `onPress: (e: PressEvent) => void`, `value: string`. Commonly needed props inherited from the react-aria-components base; the full react-aria-components SwitchProps surface is also legal.

Theming hooks: `--ds-switch-*` component-tier tokens (see registries/tokens-index.json); they belong to this component ONLY (NR-008).

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `Switch` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Switch onChange={setNotifications}>Enable notifications</Switch>
<Switch isSelected={isDark} onChange={setIsDark}>Dark mode</Switch>
<Switch isDisabled>Beta features</Switch>
```
